name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, point ad - Am 9
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: (ad) commit the Member States to a foreign, development and security policy that gives priority to the protection of women and human rights defenders against dictatorial, totalitarian and misogynistic regimes; stress that external action and foreign policy must be fully consistent with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and grounded in respect for human dignity;
